actions.message: LevelX version is fixed and cannot be modified.

profile_type.title: Profile selection
profile_type.description: Configuration profiles are predefined configuration settings where flags take default values.

oneOf.title: Default
oneOf.description: A profile that configures all the flags with their default values.

oneOf.title: Low footprint
oneOf.description: A profile where the size of final binary is optimized.

actions.message: The Low Footprint profile is currently unavailable.

lx_standalone.description: When set to 'No OS', LevelX runs in standalone mode. If set to 'FreeRTOS', LevelX operates within a FreeRTOS environment, which requires the FreeRTOS middleware to be enabled in your project.
lx_standalone.title: Select operating system

actions.message: Enable the FreeRTOS middleware to select this operating system.

lx_thread_safe_enable.title: Thread safe
lx_thread_safe_enable.description: LevelX is made thread-safe by using an RTOS mutex object throughout the API.

lx_nor_sector_size.title: Sector size
lx_nor_sector_size.description: The sector size is in units of 32-bit words. This sector size should match the sector size used in file system.

actions.message: Enable NOR flash support to configure the sector size.

lx_free_sector_data_verify.title: Free sector data verify
lx_free_sector_data_verify.description: NOR instance open logic verifies that all free NOR sectors contain only ones.

actions.message: Enable NOR flash support to configure free sector data verify.

lx_nor_disable_extended_cache.title: Extended cache
lx_nor_disable_extended_cache.description: Extended cache is used to improve performance by reducing direct access to slower NOR flash memory during read and write operations.

actions.message: Enable NOR flash support to configure the extended cache.

lx_nor_extended_cache_size.title: Extended cache size
lx_nor_extended_cache_size.description: By default this value is 8, which represents a maximum of 8 sectors that can be cached in a NOR instance.

actions.message: Enable NOR flash support to configure the extended cache size.

lx_nor_sector_mapping_cache_size.title: Sector mapping cache size
lx_nor_sector_mapping_cache_size.description: By default this value is 16 and defines the logical sector mapping cache size. Large values improve performance, but cost memory. The minimum size is 8 and all values must be a power of 2.

actions.message: Must be a power of two
Enable NOR flash support to configure the sector mapping cache size.

lx_nor_enable_mapping_bitmap.title: Mapping bitmap
lx_nor_enable_mapping_bitmap.description: Determine if logical sector mapping bitmap should be enabled in extended cache. Cache memory will be allocated to sector mapping bitmap first. One bit can be allocated for each physical sector.

actions.message: Enable NOR flash support to configure the mapping bitmap.

lx_nor_enable_obsolete_count_cache.title: Obsolete count cache
lx_nor_enable_obsolete_count_cache.description: Determine if obsolete count cache should be enabled in extended cache. Cache memory will be allocated to obsolete count cache after the mapping bitmap if enabled, and the rest of the cache memory is allocated to sector cache.

actions.message: Enable NOR flash support to configure the obsolete count cache.

lx_nor_obsolete_count_cache_type.title: Obsolete count cache type
lx_nor_obsolete_count_cache_type.description: If number of sectors per block is greater than 256, use USHORT instead of UCHAR.

actions.message: Enable NOR flash support to configure the obsolete count cache type.

lx_nand_flash_max_metadata_blocks.title: Flash max metadata blocks
lx_nand_flash_max_metadata_blocks.description: By default this value is 4, which represents a maximum of 4 blocks that can be allocated for metadata.

actions.message: Enable NAND flash support to configure the max metadata blocks.

generate_levelx_init_code.title: Generate initialization code
generate_levelx_init_code.description: Generate the application code that initializes the LevelX stack in main task within the app_levelx_init function when an operating system is selected.

actions.message: Select an operating system to generate initialization code.

levelx_app_task_entry_name.title: Application task entry name
levelx_app_task_entry_name.description: Specify the function name that will serve as the entry point for the main LevelX application task.

actions.message: Enable generate initialization code and set operating system to FreeRTOS to configure this field.

levelx_app_task_name.title: Application task name
levelx_app_task_name.description: Specify the name to be assigned to the LevelX main task.

actions.message: Enable generate initialization code and set operating system to FreeRTOS to configure this field.

levelx_app_task_priority.title: Application task priority
levelx_app_task_priority.description: Set the priority level for the main LevelX application task.

actions.message: Enable generate initialization code and set operating system to FreeRTOS to configure this field.

levelx_app_stack_size.title: Application task stack size
levelx_app_stack_size.description: Define the stack size allocated for the main task.

actions.message: Enable generate initialization code and set operating system to FreeRTOS to configure this field.

interface_type.description: Select the interface type for this configuration. Available options depend on your project's hardware and middleware setup.

transfer_mode.title: Select the transfer mode
transfer_mode.description: Select the transfer mode for data operations. Options include Polling, DMA no OS, or DMA with OS, based on your system and interface configuration.

oneOf.title: DMA OS
oneOf.description: When using the DMA OS mode with FreeRTOS, configure the NVIC interrupt priority of the SPI/XSPI IP to a numerical value greater than FreeRTOS configLIBRARY_MAX_SYSCALL_INTERRUPT_PRIORITY flag value.

actions.message: Select an operating system to use DMA in OS mode.
Select an interface type first.

stm32_lx_nor_flag_all.title: Apply all NOR flash options
stm32_lx_nor_flag_all.description: Combination of all defined flags (bitwise OR).

stm32_lx_nor_flag_start_address.title: Start address
stm32_lx_nor_flag_start_address.description: Indicates the start address of the NOR flash.

actions.message: Disable 'Apply all NOR flash options' to configure this flag individually.

stm32_lx_nor_flag_block_size.title: Block size
stm32_lx_nor_flag_block_size.description: Specifies the block size for erase/read/write operations.

actions.message: Disable 'Apply all NOR flash options' to configure this flag individually.

stm32_lx_nor_flag_flash_size.title: Flash size
stm32_lx_nor_flag_flash_size.description: Represents the total size of the NOR flash memory.

actions.message: Disable 'Apply all NOR flash options' to configure this flag individually.

stm32_lx_nor_flag_cache_maintenance.title: Cache maintenance
stm32_lx_nor_flag_cache_maintenance.description: Enables cache maintenance operations for data coherency.

actions.message: Disable 'Apply all NOR flash options' to configure this flag individually.

op_timeout.title: Operation timeout
op_timeout.description: Specifies the timeout value for NOR flash memory operations.

interface_mode.title: Interface mode
interface_mode.description: Interface mode specifies the communication protocol between the microcontroller and the memory device

oneOf.title: SPI mode
oneOf.description: Uses standard SPI (1-1-1 protocol), default after power-on, compatible with basic SPI controllers, lower speed.

oneOf.title: OPI mode
oneOf.description: Uses Octal Peripheral Interface (8-8-8 protocol), much higher speed, requires hardware support and special initialization

transfer_rate.title: Transfer rate
transfer_rate.description: Transfer rate specifies the data transfer method used between the microcontroller and the memory device.

oneOf.title: Single transfer rate (STR)
oneOf.description: Transfers data on one clock edge per cycle (standard mode, default after power-on, lower speed).

oneOf.title: Double transfer rate (DTR)
oneOf.description: Transfers data on both clock edges per cycle (higher speed, requires hardware support and initialization).

stm32_lx_nand_flag_all.title: Apply all NAND flash options
stm32_lx_nand_flag_all.description: Combination of all defined flags (bitwise OR).

stm32_lx_nand_flag_start_block.title: Start block
stm32_lx_nand_flag_start_block.description: Indicates the starting block number of the NAND flash.

actions.message: Disable 'Apply all NAND flash options' to configure this flag individually.

stm32_lx_nand_flag_total_blocks.title: Total blocks
stm32_lx_nand_flag_total_blocks.description: Specifies the total number of blocks in the NAND flash.

actions.message: Disable 'Apply all NAND flash options' to configure this flag individually.

stm32_lx_nand_flag_cache_maintenance.title: Cache maintenance
stm32_lx_nand_flag_cache_maintenance.description: Enables cache maintenance operations for data coherency.

actions.message: Disable 'Apply all NAND flash options' to configure this flag individually.

nand_op_timeout.title: Operation timeout
nand_op_timeout.description: Specifies the timeout value for NAND flash memory operations.

generate_levelx_interface_init_code.description: Generate application code that initializes the LevelX stack in a separate task for each interface, allowing independent management per interface when an operating system is selected.

levelx_interface_app_task_entry_name.description: Specify the name of the task entry function that will serve the LevelX interface.

levelx_interface_app_task_name.title: Task name
levelx_interface_app_task_name.description: Specify the name to be assigned to the LevelX interface task.

levelx_interface_app_task_priority.title: Task priority

levelx_interface_app_stack_size.title: Task stack size

nor_flash_format.title: Generate NOR flash format function
nor_flash_format.description: Generate code for the NOR flash format function, which erases all non-erased blocks and sets the erase count for each block in the NOR flash instance.

nor_flash_extended_open.title: Generate NOR flash extended open function
nor_flash_extended_open.description: Generate code for the extended NOR flash open function, which initializes and prepares a NOR flash instance for use in the application.

nand_flash_extended_format.title: Generate NAND flash extended format function
nand_flash_extended_format.description: Generate code for the NAND flash extended format function, which erases and formats all blocks, allocates metadata blocks, and initializes the NAND flash instance.

nand_flash_extended_open.title: Generate NAND flash extended open function
nand_flash_extended_open.description: Generate code for the NAND flash extended open function, which opens a NAND flash instance, checks its integrity, initializes metadata, and prepares it for use.
